items.t: Engine oil sludge buildup
items.job: Drop oil pan, clean oil pickup screen, flush and change oil
items.note: Price assumes the engine is not yet damaged. If it knocks or lost oil pressure, a used or rebuilt engine costs far more.

items.t: Alarm wiring connector can make the engine stall (recall)
items.job: Repair theft alarm wiring connector
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front subframe welds may be weak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair or replace front subframe
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Spare tire carrier cable rusting through (recall)
items.job: Replace spare tire carrier assembly
items.note: Covered by two recalls on many years. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Power steering rack leaking
items.job: Replace power steering rack and align front wheels
items.note: Remanufactured racks cost less than new. A wheel alignment is needed afterward.

items.t: Shift lever can leave Park without the brake pressed (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace shift lock mechanism
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley can separate and throw the power steering belt (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley and drive belt
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power liftgate struts wearing out early (recall)
items.job: Replace liftgate support struts (pair)
items.note: Price is for a pair. Recall covers many 2004-2006 vans, so check your VIN first.

items.t: Loose floor carpet can catch the gas pedal (recall)
items.job: Secure or trim floor carpet near the gas pedal
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Middle-row shoulder belt can bind (recall)
items.job: Replace second-row seat belt retractor
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Accessory seat heater wiring can short and burn (recall)
items.job: Disconnect or remove add-on seat heater
items.note: Under the recalls the dealer disconnects the heater and refunds it. Check your VIN.

items.t: Power sliding door cable and motor failures
items.job: Replace power sliding door cable and motor assembly
items.note: Price is per door. Some shops can replace just the cable for less. Ask the dealer about any extended coverage.

items.t: Power sliding door can open while driving (recall)
items.job: Replace junction block and sliding door wiring
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rubber VVT oil line can burst
items.job: Replace rubber VVT oil hose with updated metal line
items.note: Toyota's free campaign for this hose has ended. If the engine ran low on oil, cost can rise a lot.

items.t: Water pump leaking coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: Many owners also replace the drive belt at the same time.

items.t: Front right drive shaft may break (recall)
items.job: Replace front right drive shaft
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake light switch bracket can cause dragging brakes (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch and bracket
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel delivery pipe may leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel delivery pipe (fuel rail)
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Damaged shift cable may select the wrong gear (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission shift cable
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt height adjuster may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt height adjusters
items.note: Price covers both front seats. Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer.

items.t: Brake booster vacuum pump may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace brake booster vacuum pump
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump assembly
items.note: Two fuel pump recalls cover these years. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Passenger seat occupant sensor may short (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger seat occupant sensor
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Stability control may not turn back on after restart (recall)
items.job: Update stability control software
items.note: Software update is free under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Second-row seat belt webbing guide may be wrong (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace second-row belt webbing guide
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Third-row seatback bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten third-row seatback bolts
items.note: Recall repair is free at a Toyota dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Oil leak from the lower oil pan
items.job: Reseal or replace the lower oil pan

items.t: Knocking noise from the engine vacuum pump at idle
items.job: Replace the engine vacuum pump

items.t: Check engine light from a failing catalytic converter
items.job: Replace catalytic converter

items.t: Transmission side cover fluid leak
items.job: Reseal the transmission side cover

items.t: Noise from the all-wheel drive rear coupling
items.job: Replace rear differential front coupling

items.t: Front door window can come out of its channel
items.job: Reattach or replace front door glass and channel

items.t: Musty smell from the vents after water gets in
items.job: Clear HVAC drain and treat evaporator for odor

items.t: Front brake pedal pulsates under light braking
items.job: Resurface or replace front brake rotors

items.t: Second-row seat backs may not stay locked in a crash (recall 26V-690)
items.job: Update restraint system software; replace second-row seat backs
items.note: Free under recall 26V-690 (Toyota 26TB24). Check the VIN first.
